newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: ARA and Mediterranean fuel oil bunkers drop $2.
newsitem.headline: ARA and Mediterranean fuel oil bunkers drop $2.

text.p: Rotterdam fuel oil bunkers were $2 a tonne lower on Monday as the barge market sagged, and prices in the Mediterranean dipped by a similar amount, dealers said.
Rotterdam bunkers were quoted at around $83/$85 fob as barges moved down to $81/$83 fob.
Total ARA demand was, by most estimates, less than 10,000 tonnes.
Hamburg prices were barely changed at $92/$94 fob. Little demand emerged.
Mediterranean fuel oil bunkers were on average $2 a tonne lower, while gas oil gained $2.
Durban prices were steady despite improved supply.
Dealers say that no supplies of fuel oil, which had been tight, were available for the next seven days.
